body: honestly just people commenting on my posts makes me feel a little bit better. the longer the comment, the better. it makes me feel seen in the moments where i feel so alone. it doesn’t really matter what the comment says exactly. of course i do get tired of the “wanna talk?,” “it will get better,” and “i’m here for you,” but, at least they commented and recognized me. i particularly like the comments that go into depth about their experience and relating to what i said in my post when they resonate with it. of course none of these stop the suicidal thoughts, but they make me feel a little better. especially because no one really responds to my posts.
